# Mara Lind (video editor portfolio) · external concept

Live: https://mara-lind.vercel.app (separate project, not in this repo)

## Layout fingerprint
- hero: full-viewport autoplay showreel video (muted, loop) with name and tagline overlaid, unmute toggle
- nav: minimal dark header, anchor links
- sections: dark, sparse headings, content-first
- grid: filterable work grid of video cards (categories as filter chips), lightbox player
- background: near-black throughout
- signature: instant showreel; hover-preview video cards; video lightbox
- palette: black, white, one accent
- type: bold sans display + neutral sans body
